what_S50_was: safe_and_interior certified a start whenever its 5 kb window sat wholly inside one plus-strand chain block with an exact reverse round-trip, without ever asking whether a SECOND chain also maps that window. liftOver reports such a window twice under -multiple and the frozen C3 gate rejects ambiguity, so the affine shortcut could admit a start the production rule forbids. Fixture F3 caught it: the interval algebra returned all 10,001 band starts where the real binary returned 2,001.
the_repair: parse_chain now carries a chain_id, because ambiguity is a CROSS-chain property: two blocks of the same chain touching one window are one liftOver mapping, not two. safe_and_interior subtracts the start-intervals shadowed by any block of a different chain, so those starts fall through to the supplement where the real binary adjudicates them. This can only move a decision from the shortcut to the oracle.

detector_positive_control.why_this_matters: two zero results in a row are only credible if the detector is shown capable of returning non-zero

no_op_proof_on_production_data.method: shard 0 of 12 rebuilt end to end with the repaired builder into a separate output directory, then compared field by field and payload to the committed pre-repair artifact
no_op_proof_on_production_data.strength_of_this_claim: Identity is at the PAYLOAD level, not merely the summary totals. All 3,452 edge-sides produced exactly the same interior intervals and the same supplement starts. The repair is therefore demonstrated to be a no-op on this data, not predicted to be one from the blast-radius measurement alone.

what_is_NOT_claimed: That the defect was harmless in general. On a chain whose target spans overlap -- a different assembly pair, or a chain file that is not the UCSC over.chain -- the shortcut would have admitted inadmissible controls. The gate is now enforced by the executor rather than assumed absent from the data.
